styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: HR data that notices, acts and proves its worth.
styles.usage: Cover headline on a 1920 slide. One sentence, a full stop.

styles.name: display-l
styles.sample: One data layer, four agents, one measured loop
styles.usage: Slide title. Keep to one line at 1920 (about 45 characters).

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Product name on a card; a door or pillar title.

styles.name: display-s
styles.usage: Card headline, the loop sentence, a quoted nudge.

styles.name: number
styles.usage: A big number or ratio in a stat block. Light weight; the label beneath it carries the meaning.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: We build the data layer, the analytics, the agents and the employee experience that let an HR function act on its own signals.
styles.usage: Cover sub-line and section leads on slides.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every answer names its document and section.
styles.usage: The slide floor. Nothing on a 1920 slide is smaller than this.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: A proof line, a lead phrase at the start of a bullet, a table header.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a slide title, in phala-deep or the product -deep colour. Text-transform uppercase is applied by the consumer.

styles.name: label
styles.sample: A NUDGE, AS THE MANAGER READS IT
styles.usage: Uppercase label inside a card or over a screenshot.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Under a screenshot or in the footer, in text-muted.

styles.name: ui-h1
styles.usage: Section heading in a document or product screen.

styles.name: ui-h2
styles.usage: Card or panel title in a product screen (Gargi answers, signal cards).

styles.name: ui-body
styles.sample: Finance has the highest voluntary attrition rate at 0.60%, ahead of Engineering at 0.57%.
styles.usage: Body text in documents, emails and app screens.

styles.name: ui-small
styles.sample: attrition_voluntary_rate v1 · hrms as of 3 Oct
styles.usage: Provenance lines, table cells, metadata. Never below this.

styles.name: ui-eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase micro-label in product screens and documents.

styles.name: devanagari
styles.sample: संगम · गार्गी · बीरबल · सूत्रधार · मार्गदर्शक · फल · संदेश · दर्शन
styles.usage: The Sanskrit product names, always beside the Latin name, never alone.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps; between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside pills and tight rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between an eyebrow and its headline; list item gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card grid gutter on dense layouts; UI card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding in product screens; gap between columns of cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Slide card padding; gap between slide sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between a text column and a screenshot column.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Footer offset from the bottom of a slide.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Inner padding of a cover's colour column.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Slide margin on all sides at 1920 × 1080.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Scale buttons, small chips, inline tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, mock screens inside cards, pills in a row.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, strips, screenshot frames. The default.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills (Critical, Queued, Stored reading).

border.note: Borders and the product motifs are the decoration. No shadows, no gradients, no glass.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: With rule: table cells, card outlines, dividers.

tokens.name: accent-top
tokens.usage: With a product colour: the top edge of a practice or product card.

tokens.name: accent-left
tokens.usage: With phala or a product colour: a quoted nudge or a service card. Use top or left on a slide, never both.

tokens.name: stat-top
tokens.usage: With a product colour: above a big number in a stat block.

tokens.name: roadmap
tokens.usage: With phala: a card for something on the roadmap, not yet live.

tokens.name: motif-band
tokens.usage: Height of a product motif band: under an app header, atop a card, or as a slide divider. 32px on slides.
